name: AP_PAYMENT_REQUESTS_INT
description: This table contains the invoice data interfaced for One Time Payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REQUEST_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Interface identifier that uniquely identifies a payment request line record.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Invoice identifier that uniquely identifies payment request and its lines.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: Unique number for payment request.

columns.name: INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which payment request is submitted.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: The invoice line amount to import for payment.

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the payment request.

columns.name: ACCTS_PAY_CODE_CONCATENATED
columns.description: Account to which liability is recorded in accrual basis of accounting.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Name of the external system from which a payment request is imported.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of party making the payment.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE1
columns.description: First line of the party address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE2
columns.description: Second line of the party address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE3
columns.description: Third line of the party address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE4
columns.description: Fourth line of the party address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINES_PHONETIC
columns.description: Phonetic or Kana representation of the Kanji address lines used in Japan.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE1
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE2
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE3
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE4
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE5
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: BUILDING
columns.description: Specific building name or number at a given address.

columns.name: FLOOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Specific floor number at a given address or in a particular building when building number is provided.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City of party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State of party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: Province of party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: County of party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code of party to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: POSTAL_PLUS4_CODE
columns.description: Four digit extension to postal code.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Location of the address by country.

columns.name: ADDRESSEE
columns.description: Person or recipient located at the address.

columns.name: GLOBAL_LOCATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Number that uniquely identifies each global location in a trading partner enterprise.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Operating language of the party site address.

columns.name: PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for the telephone number.

columns.name: PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: Area code for address phone number.

columns.name: PHONE
columns.description: Phone number of the party receiving payment.

columns.name: PHONE_EXTENSION
columns.description: Phone extension of the party receiving payment.

columns.name: REMIT_ADVICE_EMAIL
columns.description: E-mail address of the payee to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Party identifier from the original system or external source.

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Party reference from the original system or external source.

columns.name: THIRD_PARTY_REGISTRATION_NUM
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a party or party site by a tax authority.

columns.name: BANK_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code of the bank account of payee.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payee bank to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the payee bank to whom the payment is to be made.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Bank account number of the payee.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payee bank account.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the branch of the payee bank.

columns.name: BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the bank branch. This is known as routing transit number in US and Canada.

columns.name: EFT_SWIFT_CODE
columns.description: SWIFT or Bank Identification Code (BIC) of the bank branch.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the bank account of payee.

columns.name: IBAN
columns.description: International Bank Account Number of payee.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of bank account such as SAVINGS and CHECKING.

columns.name: SECONDARY_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Account number reference such as Building Society Roll Number.

columns.name: CHECK_DIGITS
columns.description: One or more digits used to validate a bank account number.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the payee bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT
columns.description: Alternate account name of the bank account of payee.

columns.name: OPERATING_UNIT
columns.description: Sold-to business unit name for which the transaction is being created.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the legal entity that belongs to your own corporate structure (enterprise).

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Code identifying the payment method.

columns.name: TERMS_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payment terms used to create installments and to calculate due dates, discount dates, and discount amounts for each invoice.

columns.name: INVOICE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Information describing the invoice created for payment.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Name or number assigned to the import set containing payment requests.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Used to group payment requests into a single pay run.

columns.name: DOC_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Value used to classify documents for document sequencing purposes.

columns.name: VOUCHER_NUM
columns.description: Number assigned to a document used for internal purposes.

columns.name: REQUESTER_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the person requesting the items.

columns.name: REQUESTER_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the person requesting the items.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PRIORITY
columns.description: Number representing payment priority of a scheduled payment. The valid value is any number between 1 and 99.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments indicating the reason for creating the payment.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: The number of the invoice line.

columns.name: DIST_CODE_CONCATENATED
columns.description: Account combination used for creating invoice distribution.

columns.name: LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Line description.

columns.name: LINE_REQUESTER_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the person requesting the items.

columns.name: LINE_REQUESTER_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last name of the person requesting the items.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_NAME
columns.description: Used to create invoice distributions automatically when you do not want to enter invoice distribution information manually.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Type of line for payment request to be imported.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of payment request imported for payment.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_SUFFIX

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
